description: 2D lock filling through a culvert: chamber at 0.18 m, upper reach at 0.38 m (outflow boundary F 62), a culvert 0.12 m high under a solid (S 10) with a valve (6DOF body, heave prescribed from 6DOF_motion-0.dat, X 111) that reaches 0.01 m into the culvert roof and 0.02 m below the bed, and a fixed second body (gate, X 11 0) on the upper sill. The weights of solid and body forcing at a face add up to 1 at most (patch 0042; before it the run blew up in the first steps).
